lines.text: Read the current school or camp packet first, then gather records, identify clinician sections and confirm medication and submission requirements.

eyebrow.text: Read the whole packet before booking anything

items.text: Confirm the participant name, program dates, return deadline and current form version.
Mark which fields you complete and which require a clinician, program representative or other authorized signer.
Check the instructions about exam timing, acceptable vaccination evidence and whether separate condition-specific plans are requested.
Find medication authorization, packaging, supply and handover instructions, including questions about nonprescription products.
Ask the clinic what it needs to complete its part and whether an appointment is required.
Confirm the submission route and who can answer health-form questions privately.

line.text: A Forms sheet with the answers those forms ask for, in the order they ask, so you copy from one page instead of finding each fact again.
